limitations: N1-only SCARED anchors are excluded from all cross-N macros to keep population constant.
SCARED has measured anchor GT only; multiview agreement is not anatomical accuracy.
C3VD reused inputs retain float32/255; SCARED uses phase1 float32*(1/255). No cross-dataset numerical identity is claimed.
Known-K and predicted-K geometry are distinct outputs; GT scale is fitted for scoring only.
Official point head is measured only in VGGT_ZS; absent in historical C3VD-FT.
Efficiency is synchronized complete-output wall latency with memory policies disclosed, not native GPU-only or streaming FPS.
Three-view memory-equivalence probes do not prove bitwise equality at N50.
Post-training diagnostics do not make reserved sets untouched tests again. No model selected or trained from these results.
